LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnableInjectionTip: When off, no knowledge is written on new game, load, or periodic correction; existing entries are unaffected.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnableBackfillOnLoadTip: Compares entries on load: adds missing ones, rewrites stale ones, leaves identical ones untouched. When off, this only runs on new game and periodic correction.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnablePeriodicRefreshTip: Polls at the interval below so changes in relations, goodwill, leaders and settlements stay up to date. When off, correction only runs on new game / load.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.RefreshIntervalHoursTip: Default: 1 hour. Polling only reads and compares without writing, so the cost is minimal; shorter intervals are timelier.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.GoodwillRefreshThresholdTip: Entries are not rewritten for pure numeric fluctuations when goodwill changed by less than this and nothing else changed. Default: 10.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnableKnowledgeBaseImportTip: On new game / load, imports entry files from the bundled community knowledge library that match currently enabled mods (including each block's shared entries): deduplicates by tag + content, fills gaps, and keeps the community's original importance. Players who only subscribe to a base mod without its expansions won't receive expansion content. Entries you delete manually are restored on the next new game / load. When off, nothing is written via this path.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnableBuiltinKnowledgeImportTip: Additionally imports vanilla entries (only for DLCs you own) and mod-independent shared blocks (e.g. "custom knowledge") from the preset library. Large volume. Off by default.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.IncludeIdentityTip: Faction name, type label and tech level. When off, this section is omitted (player faction entries are unaffected).
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.IncludeIdeologyTip: Primary ideoligion and its memes. Automatically skipped without the Ideology DLC.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.IncludeRelationTip: Relation kind and goodwill. When off, this section is omitted.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.IncludeSettlementsTip: Leader name, settlement count and nearest distance. When off, this section is omitted.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.CategoryAlwaysLoreTip: When off, the upstream mod guesses the category from tags (which in practice lands on "Misc"); this only affects knowledge library UI grouping.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.IncludeXenotypesTip: Requires the Biotech DLC; skipped entirely without it. When off, the member composition section of faction entries is unaffected.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.IncludeFactionXenotypeRefsTip: The "member composition" section of faction entries plus the "found among factions" section of xenotype entries; also controls whether faction tags list their signature xenotypes, so that mentioning a xenotype never surfaces an entry lacking that information.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnableVerboseLogTip: By default only summaries and counts are logged. When on, the full content of every faction / xenotype entry is logged.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.ReinjectTip: Re-runs injection and correction on the current save, so you can see the effect of changed settings immediately without starting a new save.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.ShowUiComposition: Show actual member composition in faction UI
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.ShowUiCompositionTip: Appends an "actual members" line to faction tooltips and info cards. Fixes vanilla member statistics misreporting "Baseliner 100%" for HAR-race / pawnkind-level xenotype factions.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.EnableKnowledgeUiOptimizationTi: Hides off-screen knowledge entries to improve scrolling performance.
LanguageData.RTCK.Set.OpenManagerTip: Manage knowledge injected by this mod, organized by pack
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.Title: Knowledge Manager (right-click to edit entries)
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.NoGame: No game is currently loaded; the knowledge library is unavailable.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.NoPageTip: Create or select a page under "Custom pages" on the left first.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.EditSingleTip: Editing supports a single entry; please check exactly one.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.NoSelectionTip: Check at least one entry first.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.DeleteOwnWarning: Note: entries auto-injected by this mod will be re-injected on the next periodic refresh after deletion; to remove them permanently, disable the corresponding option in mod settings.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.ExportTip: Exports all checked entries if any, otherwise all entries in the current list; content is copied to the system clipboard.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.ImportTip: Reads knowledge text from the system clipboard: paste the upstream standard format (one entry per line); preview and deduplication available before importing.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.ExportResultFormat: Copied {0} knowledge entries to the clipboard.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.ExportEmpty: There are no entries to export.
LanguageData.RTCK.Mgr.EntryButtonTip: Open the management page of the auto-injection knowledge mod to view the source of each entry
LanguageData.RTCK.Imp.Title: Import Knowledge Entries
LanguageData.RTCK.Imp.DuplicateWarning: Deduplication is off: entries already in the library and duplicate lines in the text will be added again.
LanguageData.RTCK.Imp.StatsFormat: Found {0} valid lines; {1} will be imported
LanguageData.RTCK.Imp.ErrorAllDuplicate: All valid entries already exist; there is nothing new to import.
LanguageData.RTCK.Imp.AddedToPageFormat: {0} of them were added to the selected page "{1}".
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.ExtractTip: When on, this entry's content can be exported as a memory cue when NPCs form long-term memories; when off, it never participates in extraction.
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.MatchTip: When on, this entry can be hit by related text during chained association; requires "Enable this entry" to take effect.
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.ErrorSingleLine: Tag and content must be single-line and cannot contain line breaks.
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.ErrorImportance: Importance must be a number between 0 and 1.
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.SaveFailed: Save failed: the entry was not found in the upstream library or a write error occurred.
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.AddFailed: Add failed: the upstream did not return an entry id.
LanguageData.RTCK.Edt.LockTip: Automatically locked after saving; periodic refresh and load correction will not overwrite this entry.
